spotlight.title: The Art of Brilliance
spotlight.desc1: At Sorèva, we believe demi-fine jewelry should carry the breathtaking allure of mined diamonds with uncompromising durability. Every piece is sculpted using Austrian AAA+ grade Cubic Zirconia crystals, hand-set into hypoallergenic, skin-safe alloys.
spotlight.desc2: Each design is sealed with our proprietary Triple Anti-Tarnish E-Coating, preserving its radiant high-mirror luster through celebrations, gala evenings, and everyday luxury wear.

features.title: 57-Facet Precision Cut
features.desc: Stones cut to ideal optical proportions for unrivaled fire and refractive sparkle.

features.title: Triple Anti-Tarnish Guard
features.desc: Nanotech e-coating protects against humidity, sweat, and perfumes for lasting brilliance.

features.title: Ethical Demi-Fine Luxury
features.desc: Consciously crafted demi-fine creations that make luxury accessible without compromise.

testimonials.name: Ananya Sharma
testimonials.text: The Royal CZ Choker Necklace is breathtaking! The CZ stones have an unreal diamond-like fire and the 24K gold polish looks completely authentic. Wore it to a wedding and received compliments all night.

testimonials.name: Pooja Rao
testimonials.text: The Tennis Bracelet exceeded my expectations. The clasp is super secure and the stones catch the light in the most flattering way. Fast 3-day express delivery in Bangalore!

testimonials.name: Meera Patel
testimonials.text: Ordered international shipping to Dubai and it arrived within 5 days! The packaging is top-tier luxury velvet and the Royal Heritage Jhumkas are lightweight yet majestic.
